claim_boundary: This stage measures only classical control arms on freshly grouped splits. No quantum kernel or QNN is implemented here and no quantum advantage is asserted; QNN arms belong to a separate follow-up stage. Every reported value comes from an executed run; failures are recorded as warnings and never fabricated.

comparison_notes.exact_mcnemar: not computed: this stage stores only one scalar accuracy per seed; paired per-image predictions are not retained, so Wilcoxon is the secondary paired test

train_subsampling.claim_boundary: No performance claim is made from this cap.
train_subsampling.note: TRAIN subsampled to at most 5000 rows per seed for computational feasibility; TEST split remains full and sealed; this limits the fitted model's data budget, not the n=10 seed replication.

environment.note: versions are those importable in the executing interpreter; no installs performed
